assessment: The source reports two Lorentzian-fit stripe wavevectors, approximately 0.235 and 0.25 times the atomic Bragg-vector magnitude, together with the corresponding periods around 4.25 a0 and 4 a0. These paired values support the reciprocal normalized-wavevector relation encoded by the card, including the unit factor 1, control/readout meanings, two-value domain, approximate-fit applicability, and single-line locator. Deterministic evaluation uses the reported central wavevector estimates and returns the normalized central period.

issues.detail: Both wavevectors and periods are approximate fit summaries; the deterministic Oracle uses only their printed central values.

controls.definition: Magnitude of the central charge-stripe wavevector normalized by the atomic Bragg-vector magnitude, q_str,a/q_a0.
controls.name: normalized_stripe_wavevector

applicability.statement: The wavevectors and corresponding periods are approximate Lorentzian-fit estimates from the two samples reported by the source.

readouts.definition: Charge-stripe spatial period expressed in units of the atomic lattice constant a0.
readouts.name: stripe_period
